what_this_is: the ONLY axial read-out this project measures. Three of the 195 cell types name their segment in the ontology label, so for those the position is in the data. Every other cell type is position-free and its axial gradient remains literature-only.
normalization: CP10K (raw counts / obs.raw_sum * 1e4) then log1p; mean over all cells of the cell type (zeros included)

caveats: the jejunal enterocyte label carries only 405 cells, far below the 2000-cell threshold used here, so every jejunal value is PROVISIONAL
these are ontology labels assigned per dataset, not a measured coordinate along the gut: a label says which segment the sample came from, not where in that segment
the generic `enterocyte` label (136 259 cells) carries no segment and is excluded from this table
no calibration from expression level to Jmax or CL_int exists in this project and none is invented here either
